pages.text: $(o)The last warden of the $(l)Ruined Citadel$(), at the edge of the void.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() It heals the whole fight. Keep your damage steady; a party that stops to regroup gives back everything it took.$(br2)Its blows can throw you far. Fight away from the edges.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Citadel Keystone$(), with the Dragonscale, raises your world tier to Pinnacle.
